final: WITH country_avgs AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), overall_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM country_avgs), kept_countries AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ca.avg_wins - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_val) as excess FROM country_avgs ca WHERE ca.avg_wins > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_val)), latter_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as latter_avg FROM kept_countries), retained_countries AS (SELECT kc.country, kc.avg_wins, kc.excess, kc.avg_wins - (SELECT latter_avg FROM latter_avg_val) as minus_latter FROM kept_countries kc WHERE kc.avg_wins > (SELECT latter_avg FROM latter_avg_val)) SELECT AVG(rc.avg_wins) as avg_retained_wins_avg, AVG(rc.excess) as avg_retained_excess, AVG(rc.minus_latter) as avg_retained_minus_latter FROM retained_countries rc
